transcript.en: Good afternoon My name's Mrs Carter and I run the before and after school extended hours childcare service.
transcript.zh: 下午好，我叫卡特夫人。我经营着上学前和放学后延长时间的托儿服务。

transcript.en: I hope you've had a chance to have a good look around the school and talk to staff and pupils.
transcript.zh: 我希望你有机会好好看看学校，并与教职员工和学生交谈。

transcript.en: I know that many of you are interested in using our childcare service when your child joins the school,
transcript.zh: 我知道，当你的孩子进入学校时，你们中的许多人都有兴趣使用我们的托儿服务，

transcript.en: and perhaps you already know something about it, but for those that don't, I'll go through the main details now.
transcript.zh: 也许你已经对此有一定的了解，但对于那些不了解的人，我现在将介绍一下主要细节。

transcript.en: We offer childcare for children from the ages of four to eleven both before and after school.
transcript.zh: 我们为四至十一岁的儿童提供上学前和放学后的儿童保育服务。

transcript.en: I know that many parents who work find this service invaluable.
transcript.zh: 我知道许多工作的父母会发现这项服务非常宝贵。

transcript.en: You can leave your child with us safe in the knowledge that they will be extremely well cared for.
transcript.zh: 您可以放心的将孩子放在我们这边，因为他们将得到很好的照顾。

transcript.en: We are insured to provide care for up to 70 children, although we rarely have this many attending at any one session.
transcript.zh: 我们最多为70名儿童提供护理，尽管任何一次课程中我们都极少有这么多人参加。

transcript.en: I think we generally expect around 50-60 children for the afternoon sessions and about half that number for the breakfast sessions.
transcript.zh: 我认为我们通常预计下午的课程大约有50-60名儿童，早餐课程大约有这个数字的一半。

transcript.en: Although we currently do have 70 children registered with us, not all of these attend every day.
transcript.zh: 虽然目前确实有70名儿童在我们这里注册，但并非所有这些儿童每天都参加。

transcript.en: It's ten years since we began offering an extended hours service and we've come a long way during that time.
transcript.zh: 从我们开始提供延长时间的服务，已经过去了十年，在此期间我们取得了很大的进步。

transcript.en: When we first opened, we only had about 20 children attending regularly.
transcript.zh: 当我们第一次开业时，只有大约20个孩子定期参加。

transcript.en: We try to keep our costs as low as we can and we think we provide very good value for money.
transcript.zh: 我们试图尽可能降低成本，同时我们提供更高性价比的服务。

transcript.en: For the afternoon sessions, which run from 3.30 until 6 p.m., it's  £7.20， But if you prefer, you can pay for one hour only,
transcript.zh: 下午的课程从3.30到6 点，费用是7.20英镑。但如果你愿意，你可以只支付一个小时的费用，

transcript.en: which costs  £3.50, or two hours which costs £5.70
transcript.zh: 价格是3.50英镑，或者两个小时的费用是5.70英镑。

transcript.en: The cost of the childcare includes food and snacks.
transcript.zh: 儿童保育的费用包括食物和小吃。

transcript.en: They'll be given breakfast in the morning and in the afternoon, a healthy snack as soon as they finish school.
transcript.zh: 他们将在早上和下午享用正餐，他们一上完课，就会得到健康的零食。

transcript.en: At 5 p.m. children are given something more substantial, such as pasta or a casserole.
transcript.zh: 在下午五点，我们会提供给孩子们更实在的东西，如意大利面或砂锅。

transcript.en: Please inform us of any allergies that your child might have and we'll make sure they're offered a suitable alternative.
transcript.zh: 请告知我们您的孩子可能有的任何过敏史，我们将确保为他们提供合适的替代品。

transcript.en: As you may know, the childcare service runs through the school holidays from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.
transcript.zh: 如您所知，在学校放假期间，托儿服务的运营时间是从早上8点到下午6点。

transcript.en: We offer a really varied and exciting programme to keep the children entertained we don’t want them to feel as if they are still at school!
transcript.zh: 我们会提供非常多样化和令人兴奋的课程，让孩子们娱乐 - 我们不希望他们觉得他们仍然在学校！

transcript.en: It will also feel different because they'll get the chance to make new friends with children from other schools
transcript.zh: 还有一点不同的是 他们有机会和其他学校的学生交朋友 -

transcript.en: spaces are available for them because a lot of our term-time children don’t always attend during the holiday
transcript.zh: 因为本校学生通常不会在假期过来，所以为其他学校的学生提供了空间。

transcript.en: In the past, parents have asked if children over the age of 11 are allowed to come with their younger brothers and sisters
transcript.zh: 在过去，有父母曾问过是否允许11岁以上的孩子与他们的弟弟妹妹一起来 -

transcript.en: but I’m afraid we’re unable to do this because of the type of insurance we have.
transcript.zh: 但恐怕由于我们的保险类型，我们无法做到这一点。

transcript.en: So now let me tell you about some of the activities that your child can do during the afterschool sessions.
transcript.zh: 所以现在让我告诉你一些你的孩子在课后课程中可以做的活动。

transcript.en: As well as being able to use the playground equipment, computers and the library, there is usually at least one 'special' activity that children can do each day.
transcript.zh: 除了能够使用游乐场设施、电脑和图书馆外，孩子们通常每天至少可以进行一项“特殊”活动。

transcript.en: For example, Spanish.
transcript.zh: 例如，西班牙语。

transcript.en: We have a specialist teacher coming in every Thursday to give a basic introduction to the language through games and songs.
transcript.zh: 我们每周四都有一位专业老师来，通过游戏和歌曲对语言进行基本的介绍。

transcript.en: She does two sessions: one for the over 8s and one for the younger children.
transcript.zh: 她有2节课：一节是对8岁以上的孩子，一节是对更年幼的孩子。

transcript.en: This is the only activity which we have to make an extra charge for - but it’s well worth it
transcript.zh: 这是我们唯一必须收取额外费用的活动 - 但非常值得。

transcript.en: Once a week the children have the opportunity to do some music. We're very lucky that one of our staff is a member of a folk band.
transcript.zh: 孩子们每周有一次做音乐的机会。我们很幸运，我们的一位工作人员是民谣乐队的成员。

transcript.en: On Mondays, she teaches singing and percussion to groups of children.
transcript.zh: 每周一，她向一群孩子教授歌唱和打击乐器。

transcript.en: We do rely on parental support for this, so if any of you sing or play an instrument and would be prepared to help out at these sessions,
transcript.zh: 我们确实需要依靠父母的支持，所以如果你们中的任何一个人可以唱歌或演奏乐器，并准备在这些课程上提供帮助，

transcript.en: we'd be delighted.Painting continues to be one of the most popular activities.
transcript.zh: 我们会很高兴。绘画仍然是最受欢迎的活动之一。

transcript.en: To begin with we weren't keen on offering this because of the extra mess involved, but children kept asking if they could do some art and so we finally gave in.
transcript.zh: 起初，由于会造成额外的混乱，我们并不热衷于提供这个，但孩子们一直在问他们是否可以做一些艺术，所以我们最终屈服了。

transcript.en: Art is great for helping the children to relax after working hard at school all day.
transcript.zh: 艺术非常适合帮助孩子们在学校辛苦学习一整天后放松身心。

transcript.en: Yoga is something that we've been meaning to introduce for some time but haven't been able to find anyone available to teach it -  until now that is
transcript.zh: 瑜伽是我们一直想介绍的东西，但一直无法找到任何人来教它 - 直到现在。

transcript.en: So we’ll see how this goes.Hopefully,children will benefit in all sorts of ways from this.
transcript.zh: 因此，我们将看看情况如何。希望孩子们能从中以各种方式受益。

transcript.en: Cooking is another popular activity. They make a different sort of cake, or pizza or bread each week.
transcript.zh: 烹饪是另一项受欢迎的活动。他们每周做不同种类的蛋糕，比萨或面包。

transcript.en: Although the younger children love doing it, we found that the mess was just too much, so we've decided to restrict this to the over 8s,
transcript.zh: 虽然年幼的孩子喜欢这样做，但我们发现太乱了，所以我们决定将其限制在8岁以上，

transcript.en: as they are better able to clean up after themselves.
transcript.zh: 因为他们能够更好地在做完之后收拾干净。
